dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: What is there to be said? I was there at the Rite of Descension too. That scared the wits out of me...

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: I honestly thought that it was over for us, that the sky was going to fall on our heads.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: But watching everyone go about their daily lives and have hope for the future anyway... I feel like I should reflect a little myself.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: If you look at things optimistically, Rex Lapis can't really have left us, wouldn't you say?
